feature_definitions.residual_momentum_6_1_standardized: beta estimated on t-251 through t-21; mean/std of market residual returns over t-125 through t-21
feature_definitions.industry_excess_60d_standardized: 60-session stock return minus same-day industry mean, divided by 60-session realized volatility
feature_definitions.max_return_20d: maximum daily return from t-19 through t
feature_definitions.overheat_5d_amount: positive 5-session return multiplied by positive log current-amount/20-session-median
feature_definitions.gap_range_overheat: positive open/previous-close gap multiplied by positive intraday range/previous-close
